```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(shadshiny)
```

`shad_chat_workbench_ui()` and `shad_chat_workbench_server()` are experimental,
provider-neutral modules for public structured assistant output. They do not
make network calls or select a model/provider.

```{r}
events <- function(prompt, history) {
  list(
    list(type = "text_delta", text = paste("You asked:", prompt$text)),
    list(type = "source", title = "Documentation", url = "https://example.org"),
    list(type = "status", text = "Public summary only"),
    list(type = "done")
  )
}
```

The handler receives `prompt`, a list containing text and public attachment
metadata (`name`, `size`, and MIME `type`), plus prior structured messages.
Native Shiny upload paths are never passed to the browser transcript. Assistant
text, tool content, attachment names, and source titles are escaped; source
URLs must use `https` or `http`. Do not place private reasoning or operator
diagnostics in events. Use `status` only for provider-returned user-facing
progress or summaries.

Retries add a new immutable response version; selecting a prior version only
changes presentation and does not call the provider again.
